_doc: Per-feature OFAT ablation arms. Each arm's env = baseline_run_spec.json MERGED with the arm's `flags` below (arm flags win). 'baseline' adds nothing (all 7 test features OFF); 'all_on' adds all 7 (identical to ../combined_features_run_spec.json). Every arm keeps the fixed baseline infra ON so the score is trustworthy and the run does not fail for infra reasons. The driver stamps OPENRESEARCH_AB_ARM=<arm> + OPENRESEARCH_AB_PAIR_ID=<paper>-<seed> so scripts/ab_compare.py can pair each feature arm against 'baseline' at the same paper+seed.
